archetype: LUXURY & APICULTURE / OLD MONEY TECH (Night Navy + Warm Gold Accents)

rules.quotes: font-serif italic text-lg sm:text-xl text-slate-100 leading-snug

entry_surfaces./: mobile-first dark navy dashboard with gold accents — top serene status bar + KPI cards, 6-month gold area chart, life balance mini-radar, vision carousel with calming photo & quote, client-side FEC drag&drop entry, public signals radar, floating Claude 5.5 AI copilot bar, and sticky crystal bottom nav
entry_surfaces./pilotage: financial cockpit — real-time treasury runway gauge, client-side FEC accounting parser (CSV/TXT), automated grand-livre breakdown, revenue/expense ledger with filter tags
entry_surfaces./radar: real-time public market intelligence — live INSEE SIRENE & BODACC official business signals stream with mandatory dated badges and verified sources, Apollo Pro toggle preview
entry_surfaces./plan: serene action planner — tactical 3-tier matrix (Aujourd'hui, Cette semaine, Plus tard) linked to radar signals and cash impact
entry_surfaces./bien-etre: 6-axis balance wheel (Radar chart: Santé, Pro, Finance, Sérénité, Famille, Sens) with daily micro-checkin and calm prompt
entry_surfaces./vision: mindful entrepreneur vision board — photo cards, financial autonomy target milestone, core 'Pourquoi' affirmation
entry_surfaces./tunnels: sales pipeline & conversion flow (Capture → Tripwire → Vente → Upsell) with deal amounts in EUR and lead stages
entry_surfaces./tarifs: 5 tier pricing matrix (Rêveur, Solo, Pro, Équipe, Entreprise) with simulated Mollie payment flow featuring prominent MOCKED badge
entry_surfaces./login: minimalist navy & gold single-action sign-in with biometric mock and instant guest access

visual_enhancers.luxury_dark_aesthetic: Deep midnight blue canvas (#0B111E) with subtle golden borders (1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.22)) and warm amber micro-glows.
visual_enhancers.gold_accents: Metallic warm gold (#D4AF37) for KPI icons, primary actions, radar axes, chart strokes and active states.
visual_enhancers.bottom_navigation: Crystal glass mobile bottom bar with 5 key anchors: Accueil, Vision, Plan, Radar, Plus (which opens Pilotage, Bien-être, Tunnels, Tarifs).
visual_enhancers.transversal_ai_chat: Floating Claude Sonnet 5.5 Copilot drawer accessible across all screens for contextual questions on cash, balance, and next actions.
visual_enhancers.data_veracity_rule: Every radar signal and accounting record displays its authentic origin badge (e.g. 'Source: BODACC du 12/08/2026', 'Source: INSEE / Sirene') and precise date.

vision_carousel_1.description: Lac de montagne paisible avec coucher de soleil doré pour le carrousel Vision & Sérénité

vision_carousel_2.description: Vue sereine lac alpin au lever du soleil pour l'affirmation d'équilibre

vision_carousel_3.description: Horizon brumeux et eau calme pour la carte clarté mentale

motion.radar_spin_in: Radar balance wheel gentle expand on mount with spring physics
motion.chart_draw: Recharts Area and Line smooth animation duration 800ms
motion.card_hover: Hover translateY(-2px) with border-color transition to #D4AF37/60
motion.ai_sheet_slide: Smooth slide-in bottom sheet on mobile, slide-in right drawer on desktop
motion.reduced_motion: All transitions fallback to instant opacity fades when prefers-reduced-motion is true

accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA with minimum 4.5:1 text contrast across all dark surfaces
accessibility.data_test_ids: All interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, and KPI cards include explicit data-testid attributes
accessibility.screen_reader: Aria labels provided for icon-only buttons (notifications, AI trigger, close modals, bottom nav)

instructions_to_main_agent: Adopt Dark Navy (#0B111E) and Gold (#D4AF37) theme faithfully to match user reference image.
Implement client-side CSV/FEC parsing so users can drag & drop sample FEC files or click 'Charger FEC Démo' to see live calculated entries (Compte 706 ventes, 606 achats, 512 banque, TVA).

Implement the 6-step loop: Pilotage (FEC & trésorerie) → Radar (signaux BODACC / INSEE datés) → Plan d'action → Bien-être (roue 6 axes) → Aujourd'hui → Tunnels (capture/tripwire/vente/upsell) → retour au Pilotage.
Every Radar signal MUST show real source tags ('BODACC 14/08/2026', 'INSEE SIRENE', 'Registre National des Entreprises') and clear dates.
Mollie checkout flow on /tarifs MUST display a prominent red/amber 'MOCKED' badge with simulated transaction status (Succès, En attente, Annulé) and plan activation.
Include floating Claude Sonnet 5.5 Copilot assistant on all screens with pre-prompted quick questions (ex: 'Analyse ma trésorerie', 'Quel signal Radar prioriser ?', 'Équilibre pro/perso').
Ensure the Mobile Bottom Bar is always present on mobile viewports (with tabs: Aujourd'hui, Vision, Plan, Radar, Plus) and adapts gracefully to desktop sidebar.
Use French (France) conventions throughout: EUR currency, 24-hour time, French financial terms (FEC, Trésorerie, TVA, BODACC, INSEE, Chiffre d'Affaires).
All interactive elements must carry meaningful data-testid attributes.
